messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":6,"verses":[{"chapter":6,"verse":21,"text":"Yet thou desirest that we should say some word against God and that He should be exchanged for the great Pluto [the god of the nether world.]"},{"chapter":6,"verse":22,"text":"Why dost thou not remember those great goods which we possessed If these goods come from the lands of the Lord, should not we also endure evils and be high-minded in everything until the Lord will have mercy again and show pity to us"},{"chapter":6,"verse":23,"text":"Dost thou not see the Seducer stand behind thee and confound thy thoughts in order that thou shouldst beguile me"},{"chapter":6,"verse":24,"text":"And he turned to Satan and said : \"Why dost thou not come openly to me Stop hiding thyself thou wretched one,"},{"chapter":6,"verse":25,"text":"Does the lion show his strength in the weasel cage Or does the bird fly in the basket I now tell thee: Go away and wage thy war against me\"."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 21,22,23,24,25 in this chapter.
